caption: The drawing features three main objects, all depicted in shades of brown and tan with intricate detailing, set against a plain beige background. At the top left is a circular object with a geometric, segmented design and a border pattern. To the right and slightly lower is a squat, round-handled stamp with a flat circular end, mounted on a square base; the base is inscribed with "EP 1772" on its front face and the top of the stamp shows a similar pattern to the circular object above. At the bottom left, there is a square object featuring elaborate, swirling floral and foliate patterns, with small indentations and intricate linework. Near the bottom right edge of the composition, the name "CHARLOTTE ANOUS" is printed in small, uppercase letters.
title: Textile Stamp
